title: DetectionEvent
description: Payload sent by an edge node (ESP32-CAM + PIR + geophone) to the central server whenever its sensors fire or on a periodic heartbeat.

node_id.description: Unique ID of the edge node, e.g. NODE-03

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of detection, generated on the node

location_km.description: Track chainage / km marker where this node is installed

event_type.description: 'detection' when an animal is sensed, 'heartbeat' for periodic no-animal keepalive so the server knows the node is alive

sensors.description: Raw fusion inputs from the three sensor modalities on this node

animal_type.description: Class label from the YOLOv8-nano model

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] normalized bounding box, optional

vibration_intensity.description: Normalized vibration magnitude, used as a large-animal cue

position.description: Fused estimate of where the animal is relative to the rail, derived on-node or on-server from bbox position + PIR zone

distance_from_rail_m.description: Estimated lateral distance from the nearest rail, in meters

animal_count.description: Number of animals detected in this event (herd crossings matter for priority)
